summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Vasu Infosec MRF & PO System. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passing after fixing a duplicate-kwarg bug in create_mrf (MRFItem(**dict, qty_approved=...) — MRFItemIn already exposes qty_approved). All flows exercised end-to-end via HTTP: seed → dev-login (5 roles) → auth/me → role enforcement (site_engineer POST /api/po = 403; non-admin POST /api/users/role = 403) → MRF create/submit/approve with item-level actions (approve+reject+modify qty) → return flow → send-to-purchase → PO create (validates rejected items excluded, updates MRF qty_ordered, computes fully_ordered) → PO PDF download (application/pdf, %PDF header) → PO received (updates qty_received on MRF) → billing update auto-computes fully_billed status → override enforcement (fully_billed with billed<received requires override_reason) → dashboard (ageing buckets present) → mrf-ageing → audit-logs populated → Excel export (xlsx PK header) → notifications listed → admin can change role. Frontend UI: login screen renders with all 5 demo buttons; login-as-site_engineer navigates to /home with role-appropriate quick actions; MRF create form works (project picker, item table, add-item, submit); MRF list & detail render; PM approve confirm-modal flow works; send-to-purchase button (testID `send-purchase-btn`) works; Purchase PO list + create-po screen load with approved items enumerated correctly; PO detail shows items/rates/GST/total and PDF download button; Billing screen shows dashboard stats + filters + item cards. Minor deprecation warning: React Native props.pointerEvents (from RN Web layer, low priority).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Likely originates from a library, not application code. Reference: browser console.

action_items: (Optional) Locate and update usages of the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop (or wait for upstream library update).

(Optional) Consider hiding the Purchase & Billing bottom tabs for the site_engineer role — currently the Home shows role-appropriate quick actions but bottom tab bar is uniform for all users, which may hint at cross-role features. Non-blocking; API-level RBAC is enforced.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 434 (fixed): create_mrf built MRFItem(**i.model_dump(), qty_approved=i.qty_requested) but MRFItemIn already declares qty_approved -> TypeError on every MRF create. Fixed by populating qty_approved from qty_requested only when None before constructing MRFItem.
server.py is 1100+ lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, mrf.py, po.py, billing.py, reports.py, exports.py, seed.py) per the 700-line guideline.

PO/MRF endpoints do not currently check that `it.qty` on a PO line does not exceed remaining approved qty on the MRF item — over-ordering is silently allowed (all_ordered logic uses >=). Consider clamping/validating.
PO mark_received endpoint accepts body: dict but never uses per-line received quantities — assumes full qty received. If partial deliveries are expected, extend the payload.
Billing auto-compute uses qty_approved as denominator when comparing qb >= qa for `fully_billed`. When qty_received < qty_approved this can under-report status. Confirm this is intended.
CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] which is fine for dev but should be locked to the production domain in production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, home, MRF create/submit, PM approve+confirm, send-to-purchase, PO list/create/detail with PDF button, billing dashboard)

rca_of_issue: Root cause of pre-fix MRF create failure: `MRFItem(**i.model_dump(), qty_approved=i.qty_requested)` — MRFItemIn (parent of MRFItem) declares `qty_approved: Optional[float] = None`, so model_dump() always includes the key. Explicitly passing qty_approved again produced `TypeError: MRFItem() got multiple values for keyword argument 'qty_approved'` on every MRF create request, cascading to 500 errors. Fix: build dict, set qty_approved only if None, then splat into MRFItem(**d).
